name: Recursive Short-Stack Bézier Clipping
definition: A GPU-optimized recursive Bézier Clipping algorithm using a fixed-size stack, minimizing register usage to maintain parallel performance.
summary: Recursive Short-Stack Bézier Clipping is a GPU-optimized algorithm that finds ray-curve intersections using a fixed-size stack to limit recursion and aggressively split polygons, minimizing expensive geometric tests.
